## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A scheduled workflow or routine definition exists that runs the pipeline end...

The system SHALL ensure that a scheduled workflow or routine definition exists that runs the pipeline end to end and completes on a fixture corpus in CI without manual steps.

#### Scenario: A scheduled workflow or routine definition exists that runs the pipeline end...

WHEN `schedule-always-loaded-surface-learning-run` is implemented
THEN A scheduled workflow or routine definition exists that runs the pipeline end to end and completes on a fixture corpus in CI without manual steps.

### Requirement: Each run publishes a summary containing the always-loaded token estimate,...

The system SHALL ensure that each run publishes a summary containing the always-loaded token estimate, number of edits proposed, number of gaps graduated, and the interactive/non-interactive split.

#### Scenario: Each run publishes a summary containing the always-loaded token estimate,...

WHEN `schedule-always-loaded-surface-learning-run` is implemented
THEN Each run publishes a summary containing the always-loaded token estimate, number of edits proposed, number of gaps graduated, and the interactive/non-interactive split.

### Requirement: A run with no graduated gaps and a surface within budget opens no proposal...

The system SHALL ensure that a run with no graduated gaps and a surface within budget opens no proposal branch and writes no memory entries.

#### Scenario: A run with no graduated gaps and a surface within budget opens no proposal...

WHEN `schedule-always-loaded-surface-learning-run` is implemented
THEN A run with no graduated gaps and a surface within budget opens no proposal branch and writes no memory entries.
